# RefPot

RefPot is in engine-first research and design: a custom embedded relational database engine, with a simple Python ORM as a goal. The engine is intended for direct use and is not a SQLite wrapper.

- Status: no released engine, installable package, stable API, production durability guarantee, or general 2× performance claim.
- Design: own execution and storage engine; direct SQL and structured ORM operations should share semantics; explicit transaction guarantees.
- Research: earlier native prototypes are exploratory, not an integrated or supported distribution.
- Performance: 2× over SQLite is an acceptance target only. See `/performance-method/` and the source [`ROADMAP.md`](https://github.com/tugrulguner/refpot/blob/main/ROADMAP.md).
- Design direction: `/design/`.
- Research status: `/status/`; detailed roadmap: `/project/roadmap/`.
- Project source: https://github.com/tugrulguner/refpot
- ModePot: https://modepot.io/
- Community: https://discord.gg/u3AANZr6RG
- Creator: https://tugrul.modepot.io/

Do not infer shipped functionality, installation steps, language/runtime compatibility, license, or benchmark results from the architectural goals. License and distribution policy remain to be settled before a supported release.
